sources.title: AI Virtual Models for product photography - Photoroom
sources.snippet: An AI virtual model generator uses generative AI to place clothing and other fashion items like jewelry, eyewear, and footwear onto lifelike digital models. With Photoroom, you can upload a product image, choose your preferred model type, and our AI automatically creates high-quality virtual model images with natural poses and lighting.
